# **JFK to Hostels International NYC**

From JFK, you will have to make a long walk. Please try to exit along **Terminal 8**.

![][image2]

From here, please proceed to the exit and then walk to the **Howard Beach-JFK Airport** subway stop on the **A train**.

![][image3]

**NOTE**: Please be aware that you will have to pay a $3.00 fare to ride the subway.

Please be sure you are on the **Inwood-207 St/Northbound A train**. You will then take the **A train** to **Times Square-42nd Street.** This will take you approximately 1 hour and 12 minutes on the **A** **train**.

**![][image4]**

From **Times Square-42nd Street,** you will have to transfer to the **1 train.** Please follow the appropriate signs found at each point within the station complex to find the **1 train.** 

Once you are at the **1 train platform,** please ensure you take the **Bronx-bound/Northbound** **1 train** to **103rd Street,** located on **Broadway** and **W 103rd St**.  
**![][image5]**

From there, you simply walk from **Broadway** to **Amsterdam Ave** on the same block until you reach the **HI New York City Hostel**.

# LaGuardia (LGA)

# **Welcome\!**

eeee

# **LaGuardia to Hostels International NYC**

From LaGuardia Airport, exit through **Terminal B**

![][image6]

From there, travel to the **Q72 Bus Stop at 94th Street/Ditmas Blvd,** which is located between 94th Street and Ditmas Blvd.   
![][image7]

Take the **Q72** bus until you reach the bus stop called **Junction Blvd/Roosevelt Av**, which is located between Junction Blvd and 38th Avenue.   
‘![][image8]

After reaching the stop, walk to the train station called **Junction Blvd (also seen above)** with the **7 train**.

**NOTE**: Please be aware that you will have to pay a $3.00 fare to ride the subway.

Please take the **7 train on the Manhattan-bound/Southbound track** until you reach the train station called **Times Square-42nd Street**. This will be approximately a 17-minute train ride, depending on whether there are delays or not.

![][image9]

From **Times Square-42nd Street,** you will have to transfer to the **1 train.** Please follow the appropriate signs found at each point within the station complex to find the **1 train.** 

Once you are at the **1 train platform,** please be sure you take the **Bronx-bound/Northbound 1 train** to **103rd Street,** which is located on **Broadway** and **W 103rd St**.

**![][image5]**  
From there, you simply walk from **Broadway** to **Amsterdam Ave** on the same block until you reach the **HI New York City Hostel**.
